ancestries.name: Ambril
ancestries.overview:
# Ambril

**Status:** Playtest

**Starting values:** HP +2, base Speed 6, +0 coins.

**Origin:** Morrowline

Ambril built a chain of settlements across the narrow habitable band of Morrowline. Their shelter keepers are known for opening their doors to strangers, even when those strangers have nowhere else to go.

traits.name: Shed the Heat
traits.text: Your collar spreads as the heat hits. Once per scene, when you gain temporary Burning, spend your Reaction to reduce its rating by 1, to a minimum of 0.

traits.name: Hold the Warmth
traits.text: You pull your limbs close and let the cold pass. You have Cold resistance 1.

traits.name: The Long Crossing
traits.text: You keep enough in reserve for the distance home. Gain 1 Boon on checks to endure environmental heat, cold or exertion during overland travel.

traits.name: Shelter Keeper
traits.text: You make sure the person beside you gets warm first. Once per scene as a Maneuver, use appropriate shelter or insulation to reduce temporary Freezing by 1 on yourself or one adjacent creature. You must be able to reach the target.

traits.name: Feet on Frost
traits.text: Three points of contact leave you room to shift your weight. Ice and frost do not increase your voluntary movement cost. Other terrain costs and hazards apply.

ancestries.name: Human
ancestries.overview:
# Human

**Status:** Playtest

**Starting values:** HP +2, base Speed 6, +0 coins.

**Origin:** Waycross

Human settlements are scattered across the frontier. Waycross, a meeting point for families who arrived on different ships and never agreed on a single way to live, is one of their largest homes.

traits.name: Make It Fit
traits.text: You find a job for the person standing beside you. Once per scene, when an adjacent ally is about to roll for a noncombat task you can physically help with, spend your Reaction to give that roll 1 Boon.

traits.name: Learn on the Job
traits.text: You make a little time to learn what everyone else takes for granted. Gain 1 extra DP in your level-0 purchase pool and 1 extra DP when you reach level 3. Each grant follows the rules for that pool.

traits.name: Second Approach
traits.text: You take the hint and change the plan. Once per scene, after a Weak result on a noncombat progress task, gain 1 Boon on your next roll on that task before the scene ends if you use a different attribute and explain the new approach.

traits.name: Get There First
traits.text: When the call comes, you are already moving. At the start of your first turn in combat, gain 2 extra squares of movement for that turn.

traits.name: A Name at Every Dock
traits.text: Someone in this port knows someone you helped. Once per visit to a populated port, spend ten minutes asking around. The SA names a willing local who can introduce you to a relevant person or business, if one is present. The contact sets their own terms.

ancestries.name: Inkleaf
ancestries.overview:
# Inkleaf

**Status:** Playtest

**Starting values:** HP +2, base Speed 6, +0 coins.

**Origin:** Tern Orchard

Inkleaf were uplifted from canopy browsers. The stations that once housed their training gardens now belong to communities that argue over what the uplift was for and who should tell its story.

traits.name: Canopy Route
traits.text: You see a second path above the floor. Climbing intact surfaces with adequate holds costs you 1 movement per square. Roll as normal if the climb is uncertain and consequential.

traits.name: Catch a Hold
traits.text: A climbing limb hooks the first support within reach. Once per scene, when you begin to fall past an accessible adjacent handhold, spend your Reaction to catch it and stop there. Your support must bear your weight.

traits.name: Between the Braces
traits.text: You fold your climbing limbs in and slip through. Gain 1 Boon on checks to move through a tight opening you can fit through or to free yourself with Force while Grappled.

traits.name: Split Grip
traits.text: Your climbing limbs carry your weight while you work. On a climbable surface with adequate holds, you may remain in place and use both equipment hands. You need free hands as usual when moving if the climb requires them.

traits.name: Overhead Shortcut
traits.text: You swing from one support to the next. Once per scene as a Maneuver, move up to 2 squares along reachable, intact overhead supports with a free hand. This uses your Maneuver instead of your movement allowance. Roll if the crossing is uncertain and consequential.

ancestries.name: Lethren
ancestries.overview:
# Lethren

**Status:** Playtest

**Starting values:** HP +2, base Speed 6, +0 coins.

**Origin:** Gloam Arc

Lethren settlements grew around the archive shafts of Gloam Arc. They are sought out for records that other ports have lost and sometimes blamed for keeping records that other ports would rather forget.

traits.name: Quiet Channel
traits.text: Your sails turn just far enough for a friend to read them. As a Maneuver, send a brief, prearranged visual instruction to a willing ally within Far who can see you. The ally needs to know the signal.

traits.name: Twilight Eyes
traits.text: Faint light still gives you an edge to follow. Ignore 1 Bane imposed by dim light on checks that rely on sight. Total darkness and other obscuring effects still apply.

traits.name: Lost in the Flicker
traits.text: You move when the lamps change. Once per scene, spend a Maneuver to become Hidden from view behind cover or concealment that can hide your whole body, provided no observer can see you when you do it. Use the normal rules for ending Hidden.

traits.name: A Detail Out of Place
traits.text: You remember how the room looked before. Once per scene, gain 1 Boon on a check to find a physical change in a place you personally examined earlier.

traits.name: Eyes on the Exit
traits.text: You know where the light falls before trouble starts. Once per scene, when an enemy attack targets you in dim light and you can see the threat, spend your Reaction before the defence roll to gain 1 Boon on it.

ancestries.name: Nacreth
ancestries.overview:
# Nacreth

**Status:** Playtest

**Starting values:** HP +2, base Speed 6, +0 coins.

**Origin:** Siltwake

Nacreth communities built the tidal locks of Siltwake. Their engineers and brokers are used to working with neighbors who need the same water for entirely different purposes.

traits.name: Read the Water
traits.text: The pull on your mantle tells you where the water is going. While in contact with moving water, you know the direction of the local current. Gain 1 Boon on checks to locate its visible or reachable source.

traits.name: Tidal Walker
traits.text: Your support lobes spread over a surface that would shift under a boot. Shallow water and ordinary mud do not increase your voluntary movement cost. Deep water and other hazards use their normal rules.

traits.name: Under the Surface
traits.text: You save your strength for the work below. Swimming in calm water costs you 1 movement per square. Use normal breathing equipment and roll for consequential swimming hazards.

traits.name: Hold Against the Surge
traits.text: You settle your weight against the pull. Once per scene, when a current or surge would forcibly move you and you have a fixed support within reach, spend your Reaction to reduce that movement by up to 2 squares.

traits.name: Seal Keeper
traits.text: You have seen what a hairline leak can do. Gain 1 Boon on checks to locate or repair a leak in a suit, hatch or pressure line you can access. Use the usual tools and protection.

ancestries.name: Orivane
ancestries.overview:
# Orivane

**Status:** Playtest

**Starting values:** HP +2, base Speed 6, +0 coins.

**Origin:** Lattice Moons

Orivane are closely associated with the Lattice Moons, where a safe route can change when someone moves a cargo module. Many spend their working lives making crossings possible for the people who follow them.

traits.name: Long Reach
traits.text: Your forelimb reaches the latch before you need to move. Interact with a small object up to 2 squares away through a clear path, using the normal action and a free hand. Attacks, healing and other abilities keep their printed range.

traits.name: Tether Runner
traits.text: You pull yourself along the line without fighting its swing. Moving along a fixed line in low or zero gravity costs you 1 movement per square. You need a free hand and a reachable line.

traits.name: Catch and Turn
traits.text: You catch the rail and use the swing to put your feet down. Once per scene, when forced movement ends with a fixed handhold within reach and you have a free hand, spend your Reaction to move 1 square to an accessible space adjoining it. Resolve any collision before using this trait.

traits.name: Know Which Way
traits.text: Your balance organs catch the turn before your eyes do. Gain 1 Boon on checks to orient yourself or align a load when local gravity or a rotating structure changes your frame of reference.

traits.name: Quick to the Rail
traits.text: You are already moving toward the next hold. Increase your base Speed by 1.

ancestries.name: Pellori
ancestries.overview:
# Pellori

**Status:** Playtest

**Starting values:** HP +2, base Speed 6, +0 coins.

**Origin:** Reedglass

Pellori tend some of Reedglass’s oldest living settlements. Their growers and researchers disagree over how much a community should change to make room for useful new life.

traits.name: Close the Break
traits.text: Living fibers draw together under your grasp. Once per scene, spend a Maneuver to reduce your temporary Bleeding rating by 1, to a minimum of 0.

traits.name: Taste of a Habitat
traits.text: You have learned what belongs in a grow bed and what arrived yesterday. Gain 1 Boon on checks to identify unfamiliar biological growth or trace contamination through a living system using a sample safe to handle.

traits.name: Living Graft
traits.text: You place the tissue where it has the best chance to take. Once per day, add 1 progress after you get Standard or Strong on a wound treatment roll for a wound with a Physical wound-table result. Use the normal capability, time, equipment and daily attempt limit.

traits.name: Slow the Spread
traits.text: You isolate the exposed growth before it takes hold. Once per scene, when you would gain temporary Poisoned, spend your Reaction to reduce the incoming rating by 1, to a minimum of 0.

traits.name: Root Hold
traits.text: Your lower supports settle into ground that gives way under a boot. Soft, waterlogged earth does not increase your voluntary movement cost. It still needs to support your weight.

ancestries.name: Silev
ancestries.overview:
# Silev

**Status:** Playtest

**Starting values:** HP +2, base Speed 6, +0 coins.

**Origin:** Knell Basin

Silev are known around Khor for finding faults in structures that look sound. In Knell Basin, the question after a repair is often who has checked it under load.

traits.name: Set Against the Deck
traits.text: Four stout legs settle under your weight. Your Stability is at least 1 while you have firm footing.

traits.name: Plated Ribs
traits.text: Overlapping plates take the first edge off an impact. You have Physical resistance 1. Apply the normal rule for multiple sources of resistance.

traits.name: Through the Frame
traits.text: A motor’s rhythm reaches you through its housing. While touching a rigid surface, gain 1 Boon on checks to locate a moving mechanism or structural fault by vibration. The vibration must reach the surface you touch.

traits.name: Hear It Failing
traits.text: You feel the change before the support goes. Once per scene, when a support you are touching begins to fail, spend your Reaction to move up to 1 square to an accessible space. Resolve the hazard using your new position.

traits.name: Show Your Work
traits.text: You mark the fault so the next person can get straight to it. Once per scene, after you reach Standard or Strong on a check to diagnose a mechanical fault, give 1 Boon to the next allied check to repair that fault before the scene ends if you can explain what you found.

ancestries.name: Tessari
ancestries.overview:
# Tessari

**Status:** Playtest

**Starting values:** HP +2, base Speed 6, +0 coins.

**Origin:** Kett Anchor

Tessari freight towns depend on lifts and gantries. Many communities judge a promise by who turns up when the route fails and there is still work to do.

traits.name: Tripod Stance
traits.text: Your legs lock into three solid points. As a Maneuver while you have firm footing, set your Stability to at least 2 until the start of your next turn or until you leave your square, whichever comes first.

traits.name: Hold the Line
traits.text: You take the load before it can carry your companion away. Once per scene, when an adjacent ally within reach is pushed or pulled and you have firm footing, spend your Reaction to reduce their forced movement by up to 2 squares after their Stability is applied.

traits.name: Built to Carry
traits.text: You settle a load across your frame and keep going. Increase Capacity by 3 Bulk.

traits.name: Up Again
traits.text: One leg finds purchase and brings the other two under you. Standing from Prone costs you 1 movement instead of 2.

traits.name: Take the Weight
traits.text: When someone is trapped, you know where to put your strength. Gain 1 Boon on checks to hold a failing structure in place for someone else or to pull a creature free of debris.

ancestries.name: Weldkin
ancestries.overview:
# Weldkin

**Status:** Playtest

**Starting values:** HP +2, base Speed 6, +0 coins.

**Origin:** Kiln Nine

Weldkin descend from living bodies grown for foundry work. Their settlements remember when a contract was something written about them and when they first had the power to negotiate one themselves.

traits.name: Controlled Force
traits.text: You can feel the exact point where a stuck part begins to move. Once per scene, after a Standard or Strong check on a progress task to free a jammed mechanism with suitable tools, add 1 progress.

traits.name: Ceramic Weave
traits.text: The tendons that once worked beside furnaces still carry the strain. You have Fire resistance 1.

traits.name: Built for the Long Shift
traits.text: Your frame was made to keep its alignment under load. Increase maximum HP by 2.

traits.name: Let Go Clean
traits.text: You know what to release before the rest of the load follows. Once per scene, when you gain Grappled 1 from a machine, restraint or moving load that you can physically disengage from, spend your Reaction to remove it. This does not apply to higher ratings.

traits.name: Leave It Safe
traits.text: When you hand off the job, you show the next person where to put their hands. Once per scene after your repair restores a ship system, give 1 Boon to the next ally’s check using that system before the scene ends if you can brief them. This does not change the system die or its load roll.

classes.name: Con Artist
classes.role: Give someone a reason to open the door. Your stories work best when they fit something the listener already wants or expects.

classes.name: Envoy
classes.role: When a job depends on someone saying yes, find out what they can offer and what they need from the crew.

classes.name: Explorer
classes.role: Find a way in, a place to work and a way back. Tell the crew what they will need before they take the route.

classes.name: Medic
classes.role: Decide who needs immediate care, who can wait and where you can work. Keep an eye on your own HP and the crew’s supplies.

classes.name: Operator
classes.role: Find the gap between a locked door and the person who can open it. Prepare how you will get out before you make your move.

classes.name: Outlaw
classes.role: Know who is likely to stop the crew and when it is time to leave. A good exit can save a job a clean shot never could.

classes.name: Scientist
classes.role: Turn a strange reading into something the crew can act on. Say what you know, how you know it and what you still need to test.

classes.name: Soldier
classes.role: Choose where the crew can stand and how they can get clear. Put your training between danger and the people who have to work through it.

classes.name: Spacer
classes.role: Know what the ship can give you before you ask for more. Work with the other stations so the crew can act before a good approach closes.

classes.name: Technician
classes.role: Find out what failed before you spend parts. A good temporary fix buys time for the crew to get somewhere it can make the repair properly.

cards.name: Abort the Docking
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, when a visible obstruction enters your docking path before contact

Cancel the docking input. Existing velocity still applies and may require further action.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Administer a Medical Dose
cards.gear: None.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None — no roll

**Target / range / shape:** Self or one adjacent willing creature

Requires a free hand. The giver spends the Maneuver; another recipient spends a Reaction unless at 0 HP. Restore the medical supply’s printed fixed HP, apply Life resistance with minimum 1 actual healing where HP is missing, then check inventory. No outcome roll. Medical doses do not restore the dead or end Last Words.

**Duration:** Instant

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

cards.name: Agree on a Stop Signal
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Aid
cards.gear: None.
cards.text:

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent willing ally

Help with a declared task you can plausibly assist. Give the ally 1 Boon on their next attribute roll for that task before the start of your next turn. Outside combat, contribute Aid or your own roll to the same group task.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

cards.name: Aim

cards.text:

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible scene or item

Collect and label one reachable sample. Gain 1 Boon on your next Reason check this scene to investigate its source.

cards.name: Basic Melee
cards.gear: Requires a melee weapon
cards.text:

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent creature

Make a melee attack.

- **Weak:** 2 Kinetic damage.
- **Standard:** 3 Kinetic damage.
- **Strong:** 5 Kinetic damage.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a melee weapon

cards.name: Basic Ranged
cards.gear: Requires a ranged weapon

Make a ranged attack. Use the damage type of the weapon you fire.

- **Weak:** 2 damage.
- **Standard:** 3 damage.
- **Strong:** 5 damage.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ranged weapon

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature within 3 squares

- **Standard:** 3 Physical damage.
- **Strong:** 5 Physical damage.

cards.gear: None.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent creature

Strike with your body.

- **Weak:** 1 Physical damage.
- **Standard:** 2 Physical damage.
- **Strong:** 4 Physical damage.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

cards.name: Black Market Contact
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One settlement or station; one hour

Name the item, service or person you are looking for. The SA sets the progress needed (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress; the contact wants a favour or a higher price.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; you find a seller or broker with the thing you need.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; the contact also throws in one useful rumour about the local power structure.

**Duration:** The contact and rumour persist until circumstances change.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Brace in Armor
cards.gear: Requires worn armour; grants no armour
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Fortitude

**Target / range / shape:** Self, when taking Kinetic damage

Brace against one impact while wearing armour. Apply the reduction after resistance; the core minimum damage still applies.

- **Weak:** reduce the damage by 1.
- **Standard:** reduce the damage by 2.
- **Strong:** reduce the damage by 3.

**Duration:** One attack.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires worn armour; grants no armour

cards.name: Brace the Joint
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One reachable joint as it starts to shift; suitable brace

Hold the joint through the end of your next turn while both hands remain on the brace.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Brace Yourself
cards.gear: None.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self before a check to resist being moved or losing your footing

Gain 1 Boon on the roll if you can brace against a surface or hold. This does not create a roll against an effect that normally has none.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

cards.name: Break the Clinch
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, before rolling to escape a grapple; free hand and ready melee weapon

Gain a Boon if you can use the weapon as a brace without attacking.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Break the Shot
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, when a friendly creature enters your line before you roll a ranged attack

Withhold the shot. The action used to prepare or begin the shot stays spent.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Bridge the Service Gap
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible damaged personal-scale connection or fixture

Build a service bypass within the equipment’s safe limits. On completing 3 progress, restore the named function for the scene. A bypass does not restore a ship system die.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Calibrate the Zero
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible instrument and a known zero reference

Set the baseline before the next measurement, if its controls allow it.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Call Clear
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing spotter within comms while you operate a craft

Agree on which side and clearance the spotter is reporting.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Call the Bearing
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally within comms and one target you can perceive

Give the ally 1 Boon on their next Agility attack this round against that target if they have a valid attack line.

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Call the Count
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally about to act on a timing cue you can observe

Give them a Boon on their check to act at the right moment.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Called Shot
cards.gear: Requires a ranged weapon
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One visible vehicle, ship or creature with a system within 10 squares

Make a ranged attack against a specific system or weak point.

- **Weak:** 3 Kinetic damage; no system effect.
- **Standard:** 5 Kinetic damage; step the targeted system's die down one size.
- **Strong:** 7 Kinetic damage; step the system down one size and it cannot be used next round.

**Duration:** Instant; system damage persists until repaired.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ranged weapon

cards.name: Catch a Partner
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent falling ally; anchored harness and free hand

Catch their harness before they drop farther if the anchor can carry both of you.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Catch the Bad Fix
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing navigator within comms about to use a fix you know is stale

State the age and source before they act. They may discard the fix before using it.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Catch the Confound
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One experiment you observe when a second variable visibly changes

Flag the measurement as confounded and record the changed variable before the record is finalized.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Catch the Ledge
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, when you begin falling past a reachable sound handhold

Catch the hold with a free hand before falling farther if it can bear your weight.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Catch the Shard
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent ally before their defense against visible flying debris; ready shield

Give the ally a Boon on that defense if you can interpose the shield.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Chain of Custody
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

Each clue you collect and label can be traced back to its recorded location and handler as long as the label and log survive.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Chart Margins
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

You can read the date, reference frame and surveyed limits of an accessible chart wherever they are documented.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Suppress an Approach
cards.gear: Requires a ready ranged weapon
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility
**Target / range / shape:** One visible target in range of your ready ranged weapon

Fire to force a target back from its current position. Use the weapon’s damage type.

- **Weak:** 2 damage.
- **Standard:** 3 damage and apply Slowed 1.
- **Strong:** 4 damage and apply Slowed 2.

**Duration:** Instant.


**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ready ranged weapon

cards.name: Check the Date
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

When examining an accessible medical supply, identify its printed expiry, whether its seal is intact, and whether its storage indicator shows a breach.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Check the Drift
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One craft with two time-stamped position fixes available

Determine the direction of drift between those fixes under the same reference frame.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Check the Gripper
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One crew-controlled robot you can access

Check its available manipulators and gain 1 Boon on your next Knowledge check this scene to configure it or diagnose a handling problem. This grants no extra command.

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Check the Medium
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

Once someone tells you which sensory channel they are using, you can recognize whether your available equipment can transmit in that channel.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Check the Referent
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing speaker about to act on a translated instruction you heard

Point to or identify the object in question and ask them to confirm it before proceeding.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Check the Seal
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One reachable tamper seal you can see clearly

Determine whether it visibly tore, stretched or was replaced. An undamaged seal does not prove nobody entered.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Clarify the Offer
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One listener about to act on a stated misunderstanding of your offer

Correct the misunderstood term before they act if they can hear you.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Clear Orders
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally within 8 squares who can hear or see your agreed signal

Direct one ally’s contribution to an existing progress task. Add progress only if the ally can carry out a concrete part of that task. This grants no extra action.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Clear the Bind
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Your weapon, when a reachable obstruction snags it

Release the weapon or free it if you can move it directly back along its path.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Combat Medic
cards.gear: Requires a medkit
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One wounded creature within reach

**Healing cost:** Pay 3 HP before rolling, bypassing resistance; you must remain above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Apply Life resistance to HP restored, minimum 1 where HP is missing, capped by maximum HP. Stabilize a Dying recipient before ordinary HP healing. It never removes a scar, restores Grit or reverses Last Words. Consume one medkit use per application.

Provide emergency care under fire.

- **Weak:** restore 3 HP.
- **Standard:** restore 6 HP and remove Bleeding 1.
- **Strong:** restore 9 HP, remove Bleeding 1 and grant a Boon to the patient's next Fortitude check.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a medkit

cards.name: Compare Impressions
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Two accessible impressions you can inspect side by side

Determine whether their visible shape and dimensions match. A match does not identify who made them.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Read a Custom
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One observed practice, record, or willing interlocutor

Establish what an unfamiliar custom means in this setting. At 3 progress identify a supported meaning and what could verify it. This does not grant fluency.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Compare the Lots
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Two lots offered together that you can inspect

Identify visible differences in quantity, condition or packing.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Confirm the Signal
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally within 8 squares who can see or hear you

Give the ally 1 Boon on their next Reason or Agility check this turn to act on your declared signal.

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Convert an Action
cards.gear: None.
cards.text:
**Action:** Action conversion · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

Spend your Main Action to gain a Maneuver, or spend your Maneuver to gain another movement allowance. You may convert the Maneuver gained from your Main Action.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

cards.name: Coordinated Withdrawal
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Up to two willing allies within comms with an open route

Each ally may move one square toward the same announced exit if they can hear the order.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Appraise the Deal
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible offer, consignment, or service contract

Determine the practical cost or fair local value. At 3 progress account for visible fees and identify the largest unresolved term. The seller sets their own price.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Count the Seals
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible consignment

Check the visible seals against the manifest and identify missing or mismatched seals.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Cover the Lens
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One reachable camera lens; removable opaque cover

Obstruct its image until the cover is removed. Existing recordings and fault alerts remain.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Crawl Under Load
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, while Prone in armor

Move one square along clear ground while remaining Prone.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Cross-Check the Fix
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One current position you can compare to a chart, landmark, or recorded fix

Resolve an uncertain position. On completing 3 progress, obtain a usable fix or determine which measurement is still unavailable. This is a personal or local navigation task and does not replace a ship plotting check.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Cut the Circuit
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Your working ship weapon station when a weapon fault occurs before the shot

Safe that weapon and cancel the shot. The station action is spent. Further use requires restoring normal operation.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Dump Stored Pressure
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One reachable service valve when pressure starts rising beyond its safe limit

Vent through an installed safe discharge path. If no such path exists, you can identify the valve but cannot vent safely.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Dump Thrust
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One craft you operate when a visible object enters the intended thrust path

Cut commanded thrust before applying it. Existing drift and external forces still apply.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Emergency Jump
cards.gear: Requires charts or a nav computer
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One ship and a calculated escape route

Make a hurried FTL plot. The SA sets the progress needed (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress; the route is valid but arrives off target.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; the route is valid and arrives as intended.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; the jump can be made immediately, even under fire.

**Duration:** The route remains valid for one jump.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires charts or a nav computer

cards.name: Establish Protocol
cards.gear: Requires a willing interlocutor and a way to exchange signals
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One willing unfamiliar community or interlocutor; ten minutes

Use [Languages and translation](../rules/languages.md) to establish a limited shared signal for one stated idea: stop, danger, exchange or safe passage. The SA sets progress, usually 3; this does not grant a language or compel agreement.

- **Weak:** 1 progress; identify a potentially misleading signal.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; identify one mutually understood sign.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; establish the intended signal and gain a Boon on the next check using it.

**Duration:** Until communication conditions change; Boon applies once.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a willing interlocutor and a way to exchange signals

cards.name: Evasive Manoeuvre
cards.gear: Requires a vehicle or ship you are piloting
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** Self or one ship you are piloting

When attacked, gain +1 DR against that attack. On a Strong result, also move 1 range band after the attack.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a vehicle or ship you are piloting

cards.name: Favour Owed
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One contact who owes you a favour

Ask for a favour within the contact's power. The SA sets the progress needed (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress; the contact wants the favour returned immediately.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; the contact agrees within their means.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; the contact agrees and offers one additional piece of local information.

**Duration:** The favour and information persist until used or circumstances change.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Fence the Route
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One crew-controlled robot with accessible route controls

Set one mapped boundary the robot will not cross during this scene unless an authorized operator overrides it.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Field Repair
cards.gear: Requires a toolkit
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One damaged device or system within reach

Repair a device or system.

- **Weak:** restore 1 HP or 1 system step; the repair is fragile and fails on a later 1.
- **Standard:** restore 2 HP or 1 system step.
- **Strong:** restore 3 HP or 2 system steps.

**Duration:** Permanent until damaged again.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a toolkit

cards.name: Field Triage
cards.gear: Requires a medkit
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One wounded creature within reach

**Healing cost:** Pay 1 HP before rolling, bypassing resistance; you must remain above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Apply Life resistance to HP restored, minimum 1 where HP is missing, capped by maximum HP. This emergency-care card may stabilize a Dying recipient as its outcomes state. It never removes a scar, restores Grit or reverses Last Words. Consume one medkit use per application.

Stabilise a wounded or dying creature.

- **Weak:** stabilize at 0 HP, clear death marks; it remains unconscious.
- **Standard:** stop the dying condition and restore 1 HP.
- **Strong:** restore 2 HP and remove Bleeding 1.

**Duration:** Instant; the creature remains stable unless wounded again.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a medkit

cards.name: Find a Market
cards.gear: Requires access to local trade information
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One settlement or station market; one hour

Find a legitimate buyer or seller for one stated ordinary cargo or supply. The SA sets progress, usually 3. Local scarcity and prices still apply.

- **Weak:** 1 progress; pay a locally quoted listing fee or attract an unwanted inquiry.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; identify one available counterparty.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; identify two counterparties and their quoted terms.

**Duration:** Until local market conditions change.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires access to local trade information

cards.name: Find the Lee
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self in exposed terrain

Identify available shelter and gain 1 Boon on your next Reason or Fortitude check this scene to reach it or endure the exposure.

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Find the Shared Interest
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One willing counterpart or group that can communicate with you

Advance a negotiation toward a concrete request. At 3 progress learn the terms under which the counterpart would consider the request, or the specific reason no terms are available. They retain the choice to agree.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Fit the Harness
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self while wearing fitted armor

Gain 1 Boon on Fortitude checks to endure prolonged exertion while wearing the armor. This does not grant extra resistance.

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Flag the Ricochet
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One ally within speaking distance before they fire into visible hard cover

Warn them of the hazard. They may withhold the shot before rolling, with their action spent.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Flag the Translation Gap
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing counterpart about to commit to terms you can hear through a translator

Identify one term the translator marked as uncertain and pause that commitment until the parties clarify it.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Follow Evidence
cards.gear: Requires access to the evidence or a willing witness
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible scene, record or witness; ten minutes

Investigate a stated question. The SA sets progress, usually 3. You can only find evidence that exists and is accessible.

- **Weak:** 1 progress; reveal your interest to someone involved.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; identify one verifiable lead.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; identify a lead and one way to test its reliability.

**Duration:** The evidence persists unless destroyed or contradicted.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires access to the evidence or a willing witness

cards.name: Freeze the Scene
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally about to move a visible clue within speaking distance

Ask them to pause before moving it and point out its location.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Guard the Opening
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, before defending against a visible melee attack; ready melee weapon

Gain a Boon on this defense if you have not moved this round.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Handoff Report
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

Give the clinician a Boon on their next roll this scene to assess that patient. This does not affect treatment or HP restoration.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Haul Together
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing adjacent ally holding the same load

Give that ally a Boon on their next check this turn to lift or shift the load.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

**Target / range / shape:** One craft you operate with working controls and safe clearance

Keep the craft’s current heading and speed until your next turn, or until you issue a different input.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One unlocked door within reach when it begins to close

Catch the latch before it clicks if you have a free hand. You must remain within reach to hold it.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Hook the Strap
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

Pull a loose strap or handle toward you without entering its square.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Interact
cards.gear: None.

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible object or control within reach

Make one ordinary interaction, such as opening an unlocked door or operating a working switch. If the action is uncertain, use the attribute, time and consequences agreed with the SA.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

cards.name: Isolate the Branch
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

Close that branch at both ends to make it available for servicing. Trapped pressure or current must still be discharged.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Jury-Rig
cards.gear: Requires a toolkit or suitable parts
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One broken device or system within reach; 10 minutes

Improvise a repair.

- **Weak:** the device works for one action, then fails with a visible flaw.
- **Standard:** the device works for the scene.
- **Strong:** the device works until properly repaired and grants a Boon to its next use.

**Duration:** One action, one scene, or until repaired, by result.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a toolkit or suitable parts

cards.name: Keep It Running
cards.gear: Requires a toolkit or suitable parts
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One vehicle or ship system within reach; 10 minutes

Make a temporary repair to a damaged system.

- **Weak:** restore 1 step to the system's die; it fails again at the end of the scene.
- **Standard:** restore 1 step for the scene.
- **Strong:** restore 2 steps for the scene, or 1 step until properly repaired.

**Duration:** One scene, or until properly repaired on a Strong result.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a toolkit or suitable parts

cards.name: Keep the Channel Open
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Target / range / shape:** Self

You can attach a melee weapon to a wrist loop when you ready it. If you drop it, it hangs within reach until the loop breaks or you release it.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.gear: Requires a ranged weapon
cards.text:

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature within 12 squares

Make a precise ranged attack.

- **Weak:** 8 Kinetic damage.
- **Standard:** 12 Kinetic damage.
- **Strong:** 18 Kinetic damage; ignore the target's DR.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ranged weapon

cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

Set a comparison baseline. Gain 1 Boon on your next Knowledge check this scene to test the sample or setup.

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

Move one square into available cover if you can reach it before the camera has a clear view. Normal movement costs apply.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

- **Standard:** 2 progress; you also learn the name of one person who can help.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; you find a shortcut that saves an hour or avoids one intermediary.

**Duration:** The access or progress persists for the stated task.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Log the Conditions
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Make Camp

**Target / range / shape:** One campsite; ten minutes

- **Weak:** 1 progress; the camp is conspicuous.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; identify one safe exit from the campsite.

**Duration:** Until the party leaves or the weather changes substantially.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires suitable shelter materials

cards.name: Make the Introduction
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

Order the records by reported time and flag clocks that disagree where a common event is recorded.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Master Navigator
cards.gear: Requires charts or a nav computer
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One ship making an FTL jump

Plot a jump with precision.

- **Weak:** arrive off target with a complication.
- **Standard:** arrive at the intended system and approach.
- **Strong:** arrive at a favourable position of your choice, with no complication.

**Duration:** One jump.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires charts or a nav computer

cards.name: Match the Window
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One cooperating craft in comms and a craft you operate

Agree on a common heading and closing limit for a transfer. Give the other pilot a Boon on their next roll this scene to match that approach.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Probe the Guard
cards.gear: Requires a ready melee weapon
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** One visible opponent within reach of your ready melee weapon

Make a melee attack to drive the opponent out of position. Use the weapon’s damage type.

- **Weak:** 2 damage.
- **Standard:** 3 damage and push the target 1 square.
- **Strong:** 4 damage and push the target 2 squares.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ready melee weapon

cards.name: Miracle Worker
cards.gear: Requires a toolkit and spare parts
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One ship or vehicle you can reach

Perform an impossible repair.

- **Weak:** restore one system to d6.
- **Standard:** restore two systems to d8.
- **Strong:** restore all systems to at least d8 and remove one system wound.

**Duration:** Permanent until damaged again.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a toolkit and spare parts

cards.name: Names and Forms
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

Once a willing contact tells you how to address them and whom to approach first, you can recall and repeat both details accurately.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Note the Baseline
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One reachable patient

Record visible symptoms. Gain 1 Boon on your next Knowledge check this scene to assess the patient's condition. This does not modify treatment or HP restoration.

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Offer a Neutral Signal
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One observer who can see your hands or equivalent limbs

Display empty hands and wait for a response. The gesture does not guarantee any particular interpretation.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Offer a Witness
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing observer within speaking distance

Ask them to hear and repeat one concrete offer. They do not guarantee it.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: One More Dawn
cards.gear: None.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None — no roll

**Target / range / shape:** Self

Gain 1 additional Grit on acquisition. Purchase once ever. This does not replenish previously spent Grit.

**Duration:** Gain the Grit once on acquisition; this never replenishes spent Grit.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

cards.name: Order the Retreat
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally within comms whose planned route just became blocked

Identify one visible alternate route. They may abandon their movement before entering the blocked space.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Ordinary Exits
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

When you enter a public room, you can identify visible public exits and their posted restrictions without asking for access.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.gear: Requires a toolkit and access to the power plant
cards.text:

**Target / range / shape:** One ship system within reach

- **Weak:** increase the system die one step for the scene; it steps down one size at the end of the scene.
- **Standard:** increase the system die one step for the scene.
- **Strong:** increase two different systems one step for the scene.

**Duration:** One scene.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a toolkit and access to the power plant

cards.name: Overwatch
cards.gear: Requires a ranged weapon
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature that moves within 8 squares

When a visible creature moves within range, make a ranged attack against it.

- **Standard:** 3 Kinetic damage.
- **Strong:** 5 Kinetic damage; the target's movement ends.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Target / range / shape:** One open pack you hold and a ready waterproof liner

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Packing List
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

**Target / range / shape:** Self

**Target / range / shape:** Self, adjacent to a visible foe; ready melee weapon

Step one square to cover that is also adjacent to that foe. Ordinary movement reactions still apply.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Patch Wounds
cards.gear: Requires a medkit
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One wounded creature within reach

**Healing cost:** Pay 1 HP before rolling, bypassing resistance; you must remain above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Apply Life resistance to HP restored, minimum 1 where HP is missing, capped by maximum HP. Stabilize a Dying recipient before ordinary HP healing. It never removes a scar, restores Grit or reverses Last Words. Consume one medkit use per application.

- **Weak:** restore 2 HP.
- **Standard:** restore 4 HP.
- **Strong:** restore 6 HP and remove Bleeding 1.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a medkit

cards.name: Pathfinder's Eye
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One landscape, structure or trail; 10 minutes

Survey the route ahead. The SA sets the progress needed (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress; spot one obvious hazard.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; find a safe path or a useful landmark.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; find a path that avoids the hazard entirely and note one hidden feature.

**Duration:** The route knowledge persists for the journey.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; the next jump or journey on this route gains a Boon.

cards.name: Plot the Abort Corridor

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.gear: Requires a melee weapon

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent creature

- **Weak:** 3 Kinetic damage.
- **Standard:** 5 Kinetic damage.
- **Strong:** 7 Kinetic damage; push the target 1 square.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a melee weapon

cards.name: Preserve a Parallel Sample

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent patient whose face is about to be covered during transport; free hand

Keep the obstruction off the patient’s face while adjacent and holding it clear. This does not treat Dying or restore HP.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One reachable sealed fitting; test gauge

Check whether the fitting holds its current pressure. The test does not raise pressure.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Prevent Contamination
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent clinician about to place a clean instrument on a visibly contaminated surface

Hand them a clean barrier before contact if you have one ready.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Pull the Cutoff
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One reachable manual cutoff when its equipment starts moving unexpectedly

Cut power before further powered movement. Momentum and stored energy still apply.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Quick Look
cards.gear: None.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self before a search of your immediate surroundings

Gain 1 Boon on your next Reason check this turn to search an area you can perceive. This does not replace the search action.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

cards.name: Quick Study
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One topic, record or device you can examine

Recall or research a fact. The SA sets the progress needed (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress; a partial or outdated fact.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; a reliable answer.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; a precise answer and one related lead.

**Duration:** The information persists.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Quote the Unit
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self before a Reason or Guile check to evaluate or negotiate a deal

Gain 1 Boon by restating the quantity, terms and total price before you respond.

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Read Intent
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature you can hear and see

Study the target's manner.

- **Weak:** 1 progress; learn one surface emotion.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; learn what the target wants from this conversation.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; also learn one thing the target is afraid you will ask.

**Duration:** The information persists.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Read-Only Habit
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

When inspecting a mounted file system you control, you can mount it read-only if the system supports that option.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Read the Controls
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One vehicle console you can operate

Locate the controls you need and gain 1 Boon on your next Agility check this turn to pilot that vehicle. Ship system rolls are unchanged.

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Read the Drift
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One route, hazard field or orbital approach

Plot a safe passage. The SA sets the progress needed (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress; note one hazard the route must avoid.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; identify a safe lane.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; the lane grants a Boon to the next Piloting check made on this route.

**Duration:** The route knowledge persists for the journey.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Assess Protection
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible suit, armor set, or protective fixture

Assess protection against one stated threat. On completing 3 progress, identify its relevant rating and the most direct way to reinforce or bypass it, if one exists.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Read the Scale
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, when using a familiar calibrated instrument

You can state the instrument’s units and smallest readable increment whenever you inspect its display.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Read the Warning
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self before a Knowledge or Reason check to operate or diagnose a device you can access

Gain 1 Boon on the check by reading the live warning or status display.

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Read the Water Mark
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible bank or drainage channel

Identify the highest recent visible water mark and one nearby position above it.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Read the Weather Break
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One exposed route, camp, or work site whose conditions you can observe

Assess a safe window or shelter. At 3 progress identify a workable route, window or site from the evidence, or establish which hazard still blocks it.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Reconstruct the Route
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible scene or set of records with evidence of a creature’s passage

Reconstruct a specific movement or sequence. At 3 progress establish the route or the last supported location. Missing evidence remains missing.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Record the Concession
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Two willing negotiating parties within speaking distance

Record one concession and its stated conditions in terms both parties confirm.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Record the Fix
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One position fix available from instruments or landmarks

Record the position, time and source so a later crew can tell how the fix was obtained.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Recover a Record
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible local data store with damaged or incomplete records

Recover a specified readable record. On completing 3 progress, recover the available contents and identify any sections that no longer survive. No access rights are gained.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Recover the Approach
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility
**Target / range / shape:** One personal-scale craft you are piloting and an accessible route clear of a hazard

Make progress toward aborting a dangerous approach. At 3 progress reach the declared holding point or exit if the craft can follow that route. Use the Starship Manual for ship-scale actions.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.


**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Release the Load
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One crew-controlled robot within command range when its load snags

Command it to release the load if the gripper still works. The load falls or stays caught as appropriate.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.
