**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Reserve the Exit
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, while directing a crew in a scene

Once per scene before the crew separates, name one known rally point and a fallback. Each ally who hears you can repeat those instructions accurately.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Reverse Grip
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self with a ready melee weapon and a free hand

Ready a second carried item and gain 1 Boon on your next Brawn melee attack before the end of this turn.

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Rig the Haul
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One load you can reach and a route you can inspect

Set up a lift or haul using available anchors and tackle. On completing 3 progress, secure or move the load to the declared destination within the tackle’s rating.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Rotate the Watch
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Two willing allies within speaking distance

Let them exchange which approach each is watching without either abandoning the watch first.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Safe Disconnect
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible terminal when its connection begins to fail

End your session and preserve the last locally saved state. Unsaved remote changes can still be lost.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Safe Sector
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

When shown the position of friendly crew and the limits of your mounted weapon, you can mark the overlapping no-fire sector on its controls if the interface supports it.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Safe Shutdown
cards.gear: Requires access to a service panel and a toolkit
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One malfunctioning non-hostile robot within reach

Isolate a fault and stop the robot safely. This cannot override a hostile controller or command an unwilling sentient being.

- **Weak:** stop it until your next turn; its fault remains.
- **Standard:** stop it until deliberately restarted.
- **Strong:** stop it until restarted and give the next repair of that fault a Boon.

**Duration:** As stated; the repair Boon expires at the end of the scene.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires access to a service panel and a toolkit

cards.name: Save a Snapshot
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One terminal you can operate and one accessible file

Save a copy with its timestamp to available storage before editing.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Seal the Breach
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, when an accessible seam on your worn pressure suit tears; ready patch

Hold the patch in place with one hand. The seam remains sealed through your next turn while you hold it.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Seat Fit
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

Before you operate familiar controls, you can tell whether your restraints allow you to reach each emergency control without unclipping.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.gear: None.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self during a physically demanding task

Gain 1 Boon on your next Brawn or Fortitude check this turn for that task. This does not restore HP or Grit.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

cards.name: Secure Traverse
cards.gear: Requires a rope or suitable handholds
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** One physical crossing or ascent within reach

Secure a passage with a rope or suitable handholds. The SA sets progress, usually 3.

- **Weak:** 1 progress; leave yourself exposed to one declared hazard.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; the next ally using this passage gains a Boon on their crossing check.

**Duration:** The passage remains usable until conditions change; Boon lasts one crossing.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a rope or suitable handholds

cards.name: Segment Access
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible network you administer

Disable one named local port for the scene or until an administrator restores it. Existing permissions still apply.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Sensor Sweep
cards.gear: Requires a sensor pack or ship sensors
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One vessel, structure or area within sensor range

Scan the target using [Perception and contacts](../rules/perception.md). The SA states what the instrument can measure and sets progress if the task needs a track (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress and a contact if there is a readable return.
- **Standard:** 2 progress and classify one return by its measurable signature.
- **Strong:** 3 progress and identify one feature if the return and reference data support it. Otherwise report the clearest classification and what would confirm it.

**Duration:** Record when the reading was taken. A moving contact can leave the last known location.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a sensor pack or ship sensors

cards.name: Service Clearance
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

You can tell from visible service markings which accessible cover opens for routine maintenance and which requires a shutdown first.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Service Loop
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

You can tell whether a crew-controlled robot you can inspect has a visible manual stop and where to reach it.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Set a Return Point
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One crew-controlled robot within command range

Store its present location as its return point. It still needs a valid route and working navigation.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Set Aside a Sample
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing seller and one lot they let you inspect

Record which portion was sampled and keep it separate from other stock.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Coordinate the Operation
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** Up to four willing allies who can receive your instructions

Coordinate a shared noncombat task with a declared progress track. Add progress only if at least one ally can carry out a concrete part of the plan. Your contribution supplies instructions, never an extra action or progress on a task the crew cannot attempt.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** Self

Choose a route up to your Speed that ends in plausible concealment. Roll Agility once.

- **Weak:** move along the route. Your destination remains known.
- **Standard:** move along the route and become Hidden if you end in concealment.
- **Strong:** move along the route and become Hidden if you end in concealment. You may move up to 2 extra squares through continuous concealment and remain Hidden if you are not revealed.

**Duration:** Movement is instant. Hidden ends under the normal [perception rules](../rules/perception.md).

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Shipboard Familiarity
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

Once per scene, gain a Boon on one Piloting, Engineering or Navigation check made aboard a ship or station.

**Duration:** One scene.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Borrowed Authority
cards.gear: Requires supporting evidence, a cover identity or a credible introduction
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One willing-to-listen NPC within conversation range

Request one reversible, plausible procedural concession: a meeting, a pause or a record lookup. The SA states what evidence could support it; this is not mind control.

- **Weak:** 1 progress toward a 3-progress concession; the NPC verifies your claim.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; the NPC also names the person responsible for the decision.

**Duration:** The current conversation; impossible or dangerous requests remain impossible.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires supporting evidence, a cover identity or a credible introduction

cards.name: Borrowed Livery
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One observer within speaking distance who expects routine staff

Present a plausible role supported by your clothing or credentials.

- **Weak:** They ask for a supervisor.
- **Standard:** They let you finish one routine task under observation.
- **Strong:** They also tell you where to report next.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Change of Wardrobe
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** Yourself, out of direct view, with a change of clothing

Abandon an identifiable cover while retaining what you carry.

- **Weak:** Change one identifying feature.
- **Standard:** Change your visible outfit and apparent occupation.
- **Strong:** Also identify a plausible exit for someone in the new role.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Controlled Disclosure
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One listener about to disclose your cover identity in a conversation you can hear

Reveal a true fact about a separate issue to give them a reason to delay.

- **Weak:** They agree to hear one sentence before speaking.
- **Standard:** They delay disclosure until the conversation ends.
- **Strong:** They also tell you privately what prompted the disclosure.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: False Appointment
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One receptionist you can speak with; ten minutes

Use a plausible calendar entry to obtain a meeting.

- **Weak:** Learn who verifies the booking.
- **Standard:** Secure a supervised meeting with an assistant.
- **Strong:** Secure a supervised meeting with the named contact if present.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Paper Trail
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One inspection desk you can contact; one hour

Submit a coherent set of supporting documents for a fictional identity. Independent verification can expose it.

- **Weak:** Learn which document is missing.
- **Standard:** Pass one routine desk review.
- **Strong:** Pass the review and learn which office handles follow-up.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Plausible Cover
cards.gear: Requires plausible clothing and a shared language
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One listener who can communicate with you; one minute to prepare

Use an invented identity to make progress toward a stated social objective. At 3 progress the listener accepts the identity for the declared conversation if it is consistent with the evidence. It grants no credentials.

- **Weak:** 1 progress; expose one detail the listener can verify.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress lasts until the task resolves or the situation invalidates it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires plausible clothing and a shared language

cards.name: Pocket Story
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One listener who asks about a minor contradiction in your cover

Offer a mundane explanation consistent with what they already know.

- **Weak:** They repeat the question in front of a witness.
- **Standard:** They defer checking the detail until the conversation ends.
- **Strong:** They offer a detail you can use to make your story consistent.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: The Right Story
cards.gear: Requires a still-plausible cover identity; once per conversation
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** Self, when an NPC challenges your cover with one piece of evidence

Offer an explanation consistent with facts already established. You cannot erase evidence or force belief.

- **Weak:** gain a Boon on your next check to answer that challenge.
- **Standard:** gain a Boon on that check and one follow-up in the same conversation.
- **Strong:** gain those Boons and learn what verification the NPC will attempt next.

**Duration:** Until the conversation ends or contradictory evidence is produced.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a still-plausible cover identity; once per conversation

cards.name: Call the Vote
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One group that can hear and understand you

Force a decision or gather support. The SA sets the progress needed (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress; one wavering voice joins you.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; the group moves toward your position.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; the group commits and one ally gains a Boon on their next social check.

**Duration:** The decision persists.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Common Terms
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** Two willing speakers within conversation range

Restate a disagreement in terms both parties understand.

- **Weak:** Identify one point of confusion.
- **Standard:** Each party confirms one condition the other needs.
- **Strong:** They also confirm one condition they can drop.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Cooling Interval
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** Two willing parties about to end a negotiation you are attending

Offer a short break with an agreed time to resume.

- **Weak:** One party tells you why they are leaving.
- **Standard:** Both agree to return once this scene if safe.
- **Strong:** They also agree what topic to address first.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Introduce the Crew
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally and a contact within speaking distance

State the crew’s shared purpose. Give the ally 1 Boon on their next Guile or Reason roll this scene to negotiate with the contact.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Joint Guarantee
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** Two willing parties with authority to make a limited agreement; one hour

Write a mutual commitment with named witnesses.

- **Weak:** Record the condition holding up agreement.
- **Standard:** Both accept a limited obligation and a clear exit condition.
- **Strong:** They also name who will resolve disagreements.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Public Commitment
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One willing spokesperson and their audience within speaking distance

Give the spokesperson a chance to state one verifiable commitment.

- **Weak:** Learn which part they will defend publicly.
- **Standard:** They state the commitment and how observers can verify it.
- **Strong:** They also give a deadline and name who is responsible.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Read the Room
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One social gathering or negotiation

Read the balance of the room. The SA sets the progress needed (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress; identify the most influential person present.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; identify what they want and who opposes them.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; also learn one concession they would accept.

**Duration:** The information persists for the scene.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Terms of Passage
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One official who can grant supervised access; ten minutes

Offer a concrete safeguard in exchange for limited passage.

- **Weak:** Learn the minimum safeguard they would accept.
- **Standard:** Obtain supervised passage for the crew if you meet it.
- **Strong:** Also secure permission to return along the same route this scene.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Voice of the Fleet
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** Up to four willing allies within 8 squares who can understand you

Call a change of position. Each affected ally may move toward the same announced objective along a legal route. Ordinary movement reactions apply.

- **Weak:** One ally may move 1 square.
- **Standard:** Up to three allies may each move 2 squares.
- **Strong:** Up to four allies may each move up to 2 squares.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Cache Site
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One spot you can inspect; ten minutes

Find somewhere to conceal a portable supply cache.

- **Weak:** Find a dry spot with an obvious approach.
- **Standard:** Find a concealed site and leave a retrieval cue for your crew.
- **Strong:** Also identify a second approach to the cache.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: First Contact
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One willing unfamiliar interlocutor or delegation with a usable shared channel

Build a limited dialogue using the [language procedure](../rules/languages.md). Name the terms or topic you are trying to establish. The SA sets the progress needed (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress; exchange a simple signal.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; agree on words or signs for one concrete topic.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; agree on words or signs for the stated topic and confirm one custom or taboo the interlocutor can demonstrate or explain.

**Duration:** Agreed signals remain useful with the participants who learned them while the channel and meaning remain valid. This grants no fluency.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Guide the Crossing
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally within speaking distance before they check to cross terrain you can observe

Give the ally 1 Boon on their Agility or Fortitude check to cross the obstacle. Name the route or timing you are calling out before the roll.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Mark a Traverse
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One route you have traversed; one hour

Make a route record showing known hazards and shelter.

- **Weak:** Record the waypoints without timing estimates.
- **Standard:** Record the route with travel times and safe stops.
- **Strong:** Also record the last safe point to turn back before each known hazard.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Read the Watershed
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One drainage basin you can observe; one hour

Read terrain and water marks before choosing a camp.

- **Weak:** Identify the direction of drainage.
- **Standard:** Identify a likely flood route and a camp outside it if available.
- **Strong:** Also identify a second camp accessible from a different approach.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Survey
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One area, structure or route within sight

Survey the area. The SA sets the progress needed (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress; one entrance or hazard.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; entrances, hazards and one useful feature.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; also find a hidden route or cache.

**Duration:** The survey persists.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Test the Ground
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One reachable surface or foothold

Test the surface before committing your weight.

- **Weak:** Learn whether it will hold you briefly.
- **Standard:** Identify a safe foothold or confirm none exists.
- **Strong:** Also identify a route across for a second traveler.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Trail Mark
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One junction you can reach

Mark a route in a way your crew can recognize.

- **Weak:** Leave a mark visible from one approach.
- **Standard:** Leave marks legible from every approach.
- **Strong:** Also indicate the nearest safe retreat you know.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Trailblazer
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** Self and up to four allies

Lead the group through difficult terrain or a hazard.

- **Weak:** the group moves at half Speed; one ally is exposed.
- **Standard:** the group moves normally and avoids the hazard.
- **Strong:** the group moves normally, avoids the hazard and gains a Boon on the next check in the area.

**Duration:** The journey.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Call the Transfer
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally you can communicate with before they roll to move a patient within your sight

Give the ally 1 Boon on their Brawn or Agility check to move the patient. Name the safe point you are guiding them toward. This restores no HP.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Clear a Treatment Space
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One reachable work surface and its immediate surroundings

Prepare a clean place to examine one patient. This restores no HP.

- **Weak:** Identify the contamination or obstruction that needs removing.
- **Standard:** Prepare the surface if ordinary cleaning supplies are available.
- **Strong:** Also set aside a clean place for instruments and used dressings.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Field Surgery
cards.gear: Requires a medkit and a safe place to work
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One wound listing Soft Tissue or Bone on a willing, stable patient within reach; one full hour

**Healing cost:** Pay 3 HP before rolling, bypassing resistance; you must remain above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Apply Life resistance to HP restored, minimum 1 where HP is missing, capped by maximum HP. Stabilize a Dying recipient before ordinary HP healing. It never removes a scar, restores Grit or reverses Last Words. Consume one medkit use per application.

Use this signature as the matching Soft Tissue or Bone capability for one wound. It is one treatment attempt, shared with the daily limit across all healers.

- **Weak:** add 1 recovery progress and restore 2 HP.
- **Standard:** add 2 recovery progress and restore 4 HP.
- **Strong:** add 3 recovery progress, restore 6 HP and reduce temporary Bleeding by 1.

**Duration:** HP recovery is instant after the hour; progress persists. Only reaching the wound's RV removes its printed treatable penalties; the scar remains.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a medkit and a safe place to work

cards.name: Isolation Plan
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible treatment area; one hour

Separate clean and exposed work using supplies and barriers already available. This grants no immunity.

- **Weak:** Identify the main route of contamination.
- **Standard:** Establish marked clean and exposed zones and a safe transfer path if feasible.
- **Strong:** Also set up a second path for removing contaminated equipment.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Last Light
cards.gear: Requires a medkit
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One creature within reach that has just been reduced to 0 HP

**Healing cost:** Pay 7 HP before rolling, bypassing resistance; you must remain above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Apply Life resistance to HP restored, minimum 1 where HP is missing, capped by maximum HP. This emergency-care card may stabilize a Dying recipient as its outcomes state. It never removes a scar, restores Grit or reverses Last Words. Consume one medkit use per application.

Resolve the wound caused by entering Dying first. If it causes Last Words, this card cannot reverse it. Otherwise bring the living creature back from the edge.

- **Weak:** the creature stabilizes at 0 HP and clears death marks.
- **Standard:** the creature returns to 1 HP.
- **Strong:** the creature returns to 3 HP and gains a Boon on its next death roll this scene.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a medkit

cards.name: Prepare a Handoff
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One patient within reach whom you can examine

Record visible conditions and immediate care already given. This does not treat the patient.

- **Weak:** Record the most urgent visible concern.
- **Standard:** Record the concerns and give the next clinician a Boon on a check to assess this patient this scene.
- **Strong:** As Standard. Record what gear has already been used on the patient.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Reconstruct the Injury
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One willing patient within reach and their clinical record; one hour

Determine how an injury occurred and what earlier treatment addressed. Apply ordinary treatment rules separately.

- **Weak:** Identify one likely source of the injury.
- **Standard:** Identify the likely source and which recorded wound it produced.
- **Strong:** Also identify a clue that distinguishes it from a similar source.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Toxic Exposure Interview
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One conscious patient or witness within speaking distance; ten minutes

Reconstruct the route and timing of a suspected exposure. This does not remove conditions.

- **Weak:** Identify a likely exposure window.
- **Standard:** Identify a likely route and window of exposure.
- **Strong:** Also identify another person or area that may need screening.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Triage
cards.gear: Requires a medkit
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** Up to two wounded creatures within reach

**Healing cost:** Pay 1 HP before rolling, bypassing resistance; you must remain above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Apply Life resistance to HP restored, minimum 1 where HP is missing, capped by maximum HP. This emergency-care card may stabilize a Dying recipient as its outcomes state. It never removes a scar, restores Grit or reverses Last Words. Consume one medkit use per application.

Treat the most urgent wound first.

- **Weak:** stabilise one creature at 0 HP.
- **Standard:** stabilise one creature and restore 2 HP to another.
- **Strong:** stabilise one creature, restore 4 HP to another, and remove Bleeding 1 from both.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a medkit

cards.name: Catch the Bolt
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One door within reach about to close under its own mechanism

Catch the latch without defeating an active lock.

- **Weak:** Keep it open long enough to withdraw your hand.
- **Standard:** Hold it ajar until the end of your next turn.
- **Strong:** Hold it ajar that long and let one adjacent ally pass through.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Count the Sweep
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One moving security camera you can observe for one cycle

Watch its field of view and identify a blind interval.

- **Weak:** Identify its next direction of travel.
- **Standard:** Identify one blind interval and the route it exposes.
- **Strong:** Identify two such intervals if they exist.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Countertrace
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible terminal when a trace begins on a session you control

End the session and examine the trace request. Existing logs remain.

- **Weak:** Disconnect the session.
- **Standard:** Disconnect and identify the immediate relay if visible.
- **Strong:** Also record the request timestamp and its stated origin.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Isolated Channel
cards.gear: Requires a terminal and existing system access
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One terminal you can access; ten minutes

Build a private working session without increasing access privileges. At 3 progress establish the session with the monitoring limits the system allows. If the system cannot isolate it, identify that limit before rolling.

- **Weak:** 1 progress; leave a local setup log.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress lasts until the task resolves or the situation invalidates it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a terminal and existing system access

cards.name: Leave a Way Out
cards.gear: Requires an open path to a previously scouted exit
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** Self and one willing ally within 4 squares, when an exit begins to close

Use an exit you personally scouted this scene. You cannot pass a sealed barrier.

- **Weak:** move yourself up to 2 squares toward that exit.
- **Standard:** move yourself and the ally up to 2 squares each toward the exit.
- **Strong:** move both up to 4 squares each toward the exit.

**Duration:** Instant; this movement does not grant an attack or bypass a hazard.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires an open path to a previously scouted exit

cards.name: Quiet Entry
cards.gear: Requires a route to concealment
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** Self, with a route to concealment within 2 squares

Cross an opening without a noisy approach. This cannot defeat a lock or erase a record.

- **Weak:** Move 1 square if clear; observers can see you.
- **Standard:** Move up to 2 squares. Become Hidden if you reach plausible concealment.
- **Strong:** Move up to 2 squares and become Hidden if you reach concealment. You may shut one unlocked door within reach as you pass.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a route to concealment

cards.name: Quiet Hinge
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One unlocked hinged door within reach

Control the hinge and latch to reduce noise as you open it.

- **Weak:** Crack the door far enough to look through.
- **Standard:** Open it far enough for one person to pass without audible hinge noise nearby.
- **Strong:** Also close it quietly after passing.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Segment the Feed
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One surveillance network segment you can administer; one hour

Reroute one camera feed to an authorized local recorder for maintenance.

- **Weak:** Identify the affected endpoints.
- **Standard:** Reroute the feed for the scene with a visible maintenance alert.
- **Strong:** Reroute it for the scene and preserve both original and replacement timestamps.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Spoof a Handshake
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One network port you can access and one valid credential you control; ten minutes

Use a valid credential to mimic a routine peripheral. This grants no additional access rights.

- **Weak:** Identify the expected peripheral type.
- **Standard:** Connect for one permitted read operation.
- **Strong:** Connect for one permitted read and one permitted write operation.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Break Pursuit
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** Yourself with a usable route out of sight

Move away along terrain you can see, paying normal terrain costs.

- **Weak:** Move one square.
- **Standard:** Move up to two squares.
- **Strong:** Move up to three squares.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Cut Off the Chase
cards.gear: Requires a ready weapon of the stated kind.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One visible pursuer within weapon range next to a usable barrier

Make a ranged attack to pin the pursuer at the barrier.

- **Weak:** Deal 3 weapon damage.
- **Standard:** Deal 5 weapon damage. The pursuer takes a Bane on its next attack this scene if it leaves the barrier first.
- **Strong:** Deal 6 weapon damage and apply that Bane.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ready weapon of the stated kind.

cards.name: Draw the Eye
cards.gear: Requires a ready weapon of the stated kind.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One visible pursuer within weapon range

Fire a ready sidearm at the pursuer to give an ally room to leave.

- **Weak:** Deal 2 weapon damage.
- **Standard:** Deal 3 weapon damage and the pursuer takes a Bane on its next attack against one ally you can see this scene.
- **Strong:** Deal 4 weapon damage and apply the same Bane.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ready weapon of the stated kind.

cards.name: Duck Behind It
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** Yourself when targeted by a visible ranged attack and adjacent to usable cover

Use the adjacent obstruction to shelter. Resolve this before your defense roll.

- **Weak:** Turn toward the attacker without moving.
- **Standard:** Gain a Boon on this defense roll.
- **Strong:** Gain the Boon and move one square into available cover after the attack resolves.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Dust Trail
cards.gear: Requires terrain that can conceal a route
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** Self, with a visible escape route and usable concealment

Break line of sight during a pursuit. Normal terrain and movement reactions apply.

- **Weak:** Move 1 square.
- **Standard:** Move up to 2 squares and become Hidden if you reach concealment.
- **Strong:** Move up to 3 squares and become Hidden if you reach concealment.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires terrain that can conceal a route

cards.name: Fire on the Run
cards.gear: Requires a ready weapon of the stated kind.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature within weapon range after moving this turn

Make a ranged attack with a ready sidearm while moving between positions.

- **Weak:** Deal 3 weapon damage.
- **Standard:** Deal 4 weapon damage and move one square.
- **Strong:** Deal 5 weapon damage and move up to two squares.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ready weapon of the stated kind.

cards.name: Last Way Through
cards.gear: Requires a route that is physically possible
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** Self and up to three willing allies within speaking distance; one visible escape route

Advance the crew’s escape along the route. A participant must be able to move and follow it. Ordinary terrain, reach and reactions apply.

- **Weak:** You and one ally may each move 1 square toward the exit.
- **Standard:** You and up to three allies may each move up to 2 squares toward the exit.
- **Strong:** You and up to three allies may each move up to 3 squares toward the exit.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a route that is physically possible

cards.name: Running Shot
cards.gear: Requires a ranged weapon; personal scale only
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature within your ranged weapon's range

Fire while moving between cover. The movement is part of this action and cannot exceed an open path.

- **Weak:** deal 2 weapon-type damage.
- **Standard:** deal 3 weapon-type damage and move 1 square.
- **Strong:** deal 5 weapon-type damage and move up to 2 squares.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ranged weapon; personal scale only

cards.name: Shoot and Slip
cards.gear: Requires a ready weapon of the stated kind.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature within weapon range

Make a ranged attack with a ready sidearm. After resolving it, you may move one square by normal movement rules.

- **Weak:** Deal 1 weapon damage.
- **Standard:** Deal 2 weapon damage.
- **Strong:** Deal 3 weapon damage.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ready weapon of the stated kind.

cards.name: Breakthrough
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One problem, code, alien system or scientific obstacle

Attempt a decisive insight. The SA sets the progress needed (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress; identify the missing piece.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; solve the immediate problem.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; solve it and grant every ally a Boon on their next related check.

**Duration:** The solution persists; the Boon lasts until used.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Control Sample
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** Two comparable accessible samples; ten minutes

Separate one control from the experimental sample and document their conditions.

- **Weak:** Identify one uncontrolled difference.
- **Standard:** Establish a usable control if the samples permit it.
- **Strong:** Also identify a second variable to hold constant.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Field Calibration
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One working measuring instrument within reach and a known reference

Check the instrument against the reference.

- **Weak:** Identify whether its reading drifts.
- **Standard:** Correct the reading for one measurement.
- **Strong:** Correct it for the scene under the same conditions.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Field Prototype
cards.gear: Requires a toolkit
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One device or problem within reach; 10 minutes

Build a temporary device with one clear function agreed with the SA.

- **Weak:** it works once, then breaks.
- **Standard:** it works for the scene.
- **Strong:** it works for the scene and can be used three times before breaking.

**Duration:** One use, one scene, or three uses, by result.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a toolkit

cards.name: Hypothesis
cards.gear: Requires a sensor pack or laboratory access
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature, object or phenomenon

Analyse the target. The SA sets the progress needed (usually 3).

- **Weak:** 1 progress; identify one obvious property.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; identify a weakness or hidden property.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; the next ally to attack or act on your analysis gains a Boon.

**Duration:** The analysis persists for the scene.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a sensor pack or laboratory access

cards.name: Map the Interaction
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** Two measured phenomena in one accessible site; one hour

Compare their behavior to find when one affects the other.

- **Weak:** Identify a measurable correlation.
- **Standard:** Identify a repeatable condition under which the interaction occurs if present.
- **Strong:** Also identify a safe intervention that can interrupt it if feasible.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Reproduce the Result
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One documented experiment with available materials; one hour

Run the experiment again under its recorded conditions.

- **Weak:** Identify one step you cannot reproduce reliably.
- **Standard:** Obtain a repeat result and record discrepancies.
- **Strong:** Also test one deliberate variation and record its effect.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Rule Out a Cause
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One observed phenomenon and two testable explanations; ten minutes

Perform a test whose results can distinguish the explanations.

- **Weak:** Identify a confounding factor.
- **Standard:** Rule out one explanation if the result supports it.
- **Strong:** Also identify a prediction that could independently confirm the remaining explanation.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Sample Under Pressure
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One sample you are holding when its container begins to fail

Preserve what you can using a ready secondary container.

- **Weak:** Preserve enough to identify its broad category.
- **Standard:** Preserve a usable sample.
- **Strong:** Preserve the sample and its original label.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Brace the Door
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Fortitude

**Target / range / shape:** One open doorway you occupy

Set your footing to hold the opening until your next turn.

- **Weak:** Gain a Boon on your next check to resist being moved through it.
- **Standard:** Gain that Boon and give an ally adjacent to you a Boon on their next check to hold position there.
- **Strong:** As Standard. Apply the ally benefit to two adjacent allies.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Fire Discipline
cards.gear: Requires a ranged weapon
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** Up to two visible creatures within 10 squares

Make one ranged attack against each target.

- **Weak:** 3 Kinetic damage to each.
- **Standard:** 5 Kinetic damage to each.
- **Strong:** 7 Kinetic damage to each; one target is Slowed 1.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ranged weapon

cards.name: Hold the Angle
cards.gear: Requires a ready weapon of the stated kind.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Fortitude

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature within range of your ready weapon while you occupy cover

Make an attack from a fixed position.

- **Weak:** Deal 2 weapon damage.
- **Standard:** Deal 3 weapon damage and remain braced against the next forced movement this turn, gaining a Boon if a check is called for.
- **Strong:** Deal 4 weapon damage and retain that benefit until your next turn.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ready weapon of the stated kind.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Fortitude

**Target / range / shape:** One ally within 4 squares who is hit by an attack

Reduce the damage by 2. On a Strong result, reduce it by 4 and the ally gains a Boon on their next attack.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Overlapping Fire
cards.gear: Requires a ready weapon of the stated kind.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Fortitude

**Target / range / shape:** One visible creature within weapon range and one willing ally who can see it

Fire a ready weapon and call where your ally should aim.

- **Weak:** Deal 3 weapon damage.
- **Standard:** Deal 4 weapon damage and grant the ally a Boon on their next attack against that creature this scene.
- **Strong:** Deal 5 weapon damage and grant that Boon.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ready weapon of the stated kind.

cards.name: Rally to Cover
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Fortitude

**Target / range / shape:** Up to two allies within speaking distance who can see the same cover

Call a fallback position.

- **Weak:** One ally can move one square toward it.
- **Standard:** Both allies can each move one square toward it.
- **Strong:** Both allies can each move up to two squares toward it.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Shield the Withdrawal
cards.gear: Requires a ready shield.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent willing ally before a visible attack against them is rolled; you have a ready shield

If you can interpose your shield, give the ally 1 Boon to defend, or impose 1 Bane if the attacker is the one rolling. After the attack resolves the ally may move 1 square toward available cover if still able. The ally remains the target.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ready shield.

cards.name: Stand Through the Breach
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Fortitude

**Target / range / shape:** Yourself when a visible attack would push you from a doorway you occupy

Brace against the push after damage resolves.

- **Weak:** Reduce the push by one square.
- **Standard:** Reduce it by two squares.
- **Strong:** Reduce it by three squares.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Unbroken
cards.gear: None
cards.text:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

Once per scene, when you would be reduced to 0 HP, remain at 1 HP instead. You may also ignore one wound penalty until the end of your next turn.

**Duration:** One scene.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None

cards.name: Abort Call
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing pilot within comms before they roll to avoid a hazard you can perceive

Give the pilot 1 Boon on their Agility roll to avoid the hazard. Use the printed station attribute instead if an applicable ship action names a different attribute.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Coordinate a Tow
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** Two cooperating craft within comms with compatible tow hardware; ten minutes

Plan how to take a disabled craft under tow without overloading the attachment.

- **Weak:** Identify the safe loading limit.
- **Standard:** Establish a sequence and grant a Boon on the first check to connect the tow.
- **Strong:** Also grant a Boon on the first check to disengage during the same operation.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Drift Pilot
cards.gear: Requires a ship or vehicle you are piloting
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** Self or one ship you are piloting

Ignore difficult terrain or one environmental penalty until the end of your next turn. On a Strong result, also gain a Boon on your next Piloting check.

**Duration:** End of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ship or vehicle you are piloting

cards.name: Flight Recorder Review
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible flight recorder; ten minutes

Reconstruct the last recorded maneuver from the available data.

- **Weak:** Identify its start and end times.
- **Standard:** Identify its timing and the inputs used.
- **Strong:** Also identify a recorded deviation from the intended course.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Plot the Dead Stick
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One craft with a known position and velocity and access to navigation data; ten minutes

Calculate where the craft can coast on its current trajectory.

- **Weak:** Estimate the next point of closest approach.
- **Standard:** Plot the coast and identify a reachable interception point if available.
- **Strong:** Also identify the smallest correction needed to reach a second point if feasible.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Power Routing
cards.gear: Requires access to the power plant
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One ship system within reach

Move one step of power between two ship systems.

- **Weak:** shift one step; the donor system steps down at the end of the scene.
- **Standard:** shift one step for the scene.
- **Strong:** shift two steps, split as you choose.

**Duration:** One scene.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires access to the power plant

cards.name: Read the Approach
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One visible docking approach or recorded traffic feed

Identify how local traffic reaches a berth.

- **Weak:** Identify the main traffic direction.
- **Standard:** Identify one viable approach and its next hazard.
- **Strong:** Also identify a viable abort route if one exists.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Tether Check
cards.gear: Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One reachable tether and anchor

Inspect the attachment before a crew member leaves a hatch.

- **Weak:** Identify visible damage to the tether.
- **Standard:** Confirm whether the attachment will hold its rated load.
- **Strong:** Also identify a second usable anchor if available.

**Duration:** Instant unless an outcome states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires the access, tools or equipment stated above.

cards.name: Through the Storm
cards.gear: Requires a ship you are piloting
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One ship and one hazard or pursuit

Navigate a hazard or escape a pursuit.

- **Weak:** get through with a system wound.
- **Standard:** get through with no system wound.
- **Strong:** get through and arrive in a favourable position.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ship you are piloting

cards.name: Bench Test
cards.gear: Toolkit and a safe test supply
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One detached electrical or mechanical component within reach

Test the component on a safe power supply before fitting it.

- **Weak:** Determine whether it works under light load.
- **Standard:** Determine its operating limits and whether it fits the proposed installation.
- **Strong:** As Standard. Identify a compatible substitute among parts you can inspect.

**Duration:** Instant

**Equipment / acquisition:** Toolkit and a safe test supply

cards.name: Diagnostic Pass
cards.gear: Requires a toolkit and access to the device
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible device, system interface, or non-hostile robot within reach

Diagnose one stated fault. At 3 progress locate the cause and name a safe access point or confirm what further evidence is missing. Diagnosis restores no HP or system die.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress lasts until the task resolves or the situation invalidates it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a toolkit and access to the device

cards.name: Fabricate a Coupling
cards.gear: Workshop, toolkit and suitable stock
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** Two devices within reach with incompatible service connections; one uninterrupted hour

Make a removable adapter for one named signal or fluid connection within both devices’ rated limits.

- **Weak:** Carry the connection for a single test.
- **Standard:** Carry the connection for one scene.
- **Strong:** Carry the connection until the adapter is removed or damaged.

**Duration:** By outcome

**Equipment / acquisition:** Workshop, toolkit and suitable stock

cards.name: Isolate the Fault
cards.gear: Toolkit
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One device within reach when a fault would interrupt its operation

Disconnect a failing accessory from the device before it takes the rest offline. The accessory must be physically separable.

- **Weak:** Shut down both safely.
- **Standard:** Keep the device running through its current action. The accessory shuts down.
- **Strong:** Keep the device running for the scene. The accessory shuts down.

**Duration:** By outcome

**Equipment / acquisition:** Toolkit

cards.name: Jam Release
cards.gear: Toolkit
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One jammed unpowered hatch or mechanism within reach

Free a mechanism whose controls you can physically reach. This does not defeat a lock.

- **Weak:** Free it enough for one use, after which it jams again.
- **Standard:** Free it for the scene.
- **Strong:** Free it for the scene and identify what must be replaced to prevent another jam.

**Duration:** By outcome

**Equipment / acquisition:** Toolkit

cards.name: Program a Return
cards.gear: Robot with working navigation and access to its controls
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One willing or crew-controlled robot within reach and one route you have walked; ten minutes

Record a return route the robot can traverse on its own. It stops at obstructions and takes no other actions during transit.

- **Weak:** Record the route. The robot needs a live command at each junction.
- **Standard:** Record the route. The robot can follow it on a single command.
- **Strong:** As Standard. It can also retrace the route to its starting position.

**Duration:** Until overwritten

**Equipment / acquisition:** Robot with working navigation and access to its controls

cards.name: Rebuild the Interface
cards.gear: Requires a toolkit, suitable replacement components and an otherwise functioning system
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One compatible owned device or system; one uninterrupted hour

Adapt an existing interface to restore access, not improve its installed rating. Requires the failed controls to be accessible.

- **Weak:** restore one lost control function for the next action.
- **Standard:** restore that control function for the scene.
- **Strong:** restore it until proper service and give its next operator check a Boon.

**Duration:** By result; existing power, damage and safety limits still apply.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a toolkit, suitable replacement components and an otherwise functioning system

cards.name: Recover the Recorder
cards.gear: Toolkit and a compatible reader
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible damaged recorder; one uninterrupted hour

Read a damaged recording medium without returning the recorder to service. Erased or physically missing material is unavailable.

- **Weak:** Recover a fragment from one time window you specify.
- **Standard:** Recover the intact material from that window and identify gaps.
- **Strong:** As Standard. Recover intact material from a second window.

**Duration:** Instant

**Equipment / acquisition:** Toolkit and a compatible reader

cards.name: Remote Hands
cards.gear: Requires an existing functioning utility robot; this ability grants none
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One owned utility robot within 8 squares and one reachable non-combat task

Direct the robot to carry a small object, press a control or inspect a panel. It takes no independent turn and cannot use your abilities or attack. If it uses a personal companion profile, this counts as its one command package for the round and requires its normal controller link.

- **Weak:** complete a routine task, but the robot remains exposed at the work site.
- **Standard:** complete a routine task and return the robot to you.
- **Strong:** complete the task, return it and identify one visible hazard at the work site.

**Duration:** Instant; movement follows a physically open route of at most 8 squares each way.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires an existing functioning utility robot; this ability grants none

cards.name: Sort the Supplies
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible medkit and one willing adjacent clinician

Identify the next required tool and put it into their free hand. This spends no medkit use.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Split the Consignment
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One consignment under your control and two compatible carriers

Allocate labeled packages and produce a manifest for each carrier. The transfer still requires ordinary handling time.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Spot the Sudden Rise
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One visible watercourse when a change in its flow becomes apparent

Warn allies within speaking distance and identify one visible route toward higher ground if available.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Stabilize
cards.gear: None.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None — no roll

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent Dying player character

Stabilize at 0 HP and clear death marks. No roll. This grants no HP, removes no wound, and does not restore Grit. Taking damage while stable enters Dying again.

**Duration:** Instant

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

cards.name: Steady Hands
cards.gear: None.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self before a task that requires precise handling

Gain 1 Boon on your next Agility check this turn to handle, place or retrieve an object. This does not apply to attacks.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

cards.name: Stop the Trial
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One experiment you operate when a visible safety threshold is crossed

Stop the active input if its controls are in reach. Ongoing chemical or physical changes still require containment.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Suppressing Fire
cards.gear: Requires a ranged weapon and ammunition
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Agility

**Target / range / shape:** One 2-square-wide area within 8 squares

Spray the area with fire. Each creature in the area makes a defense roll against your attack.

- **Weak:** 2 Kinetic damage to each target.
- **Standard:** 3 Kinetic damage; Slowed 1 until the end of their next turn.
- **Strong:** 4 Kinetic damage; Slowed 1 and the area remains dangerous until your next turn.

**Duration:** Instant; the area lasts until your next turn on a Strong result.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a ranged weapon and ammunition

cards.name: Swap the End Effector
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One powered-down compatible robot within reach and a ready attachment

Exchange a quick-release attachment and secure it for the robot’s next startup.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Swing Across
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, holding a sound anchored line

Swing up to three squares to an open landing within the line’s reach. You must have a clear arc.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Tag the Feed
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible device, fixture, or service line

Mark an accessible feed. Gain 1 Boon on your next Knowledge check this scene to diagnose or isolate a fault in that equipment.

**Duration:** As stated above.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Take Cover
cards.gear: None.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self while you have cover from a visible threat

Settle behind your existing cover. Gain 1 Boon on your next defense against an attack from that threat before the start of your next turn, while the same barrier still gives you cover.

**Duration:** As stated in the effect.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

cards.name: Test the Boundary
cards.gear: Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One measurable material, sample, or process you can safely test

Test for a stated limit or change in behavior. At 3 progress establish the observable threshold within the range tested.

- **Weak:** 1 progress.
- **Standard:** 2 progress.
- **Strong:** 3 progress.

**Duration:** Progress remains on the declared task until it resolves or circumstances invalidate it.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires appropriate access and any equipment named in the effect.

cards.name: Test the Timeline
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible timeline and one independently timed event

Place the event on the timeline and identify a direct contradiction if the recorded times rule out the claimed order.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Tie Off the Kit
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One unsecured item within reach when wind or motion starts to carry it away

Catch its loop with a free hand or clip it to a ready anchor before it leaves reach.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Trace Access
cards.gear: Requires a terminal and physical or authorised network access
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible terminal or network; ten minutes

Investigate one access path or data record. The SA sets progress, usually 3. This finds a route; it does not automatically defeat security.

- **Weak:** 1 progress; leave a detectable access log.
- **Standard:** 2 progress; identify the next access barrier.
- **Strong:** 3 progress; gain a Boon on your next check against that identified barrier.

**Duration:** Information persists; Boon expires when that barrier changes.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires a terminal and physical or authorised network access

cards.name: Trace the Last Hop
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One connection you administer when it unexpectedly drops

Record the last reachable relay and disconnect time if the terminal reports them.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Track the Approach
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One visible target within range of your ready ranged weapon

Give yourself a Boon on your next attack against that target this turn if it stays visible.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Track the Exposure
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One accessible clinical record and a known exposure time

Record the known exposure and when its first observable symptoms appeared, flagging gaps in observation.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Transfer the Load
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent ally about to drop a load you can carry; free hands

Take the load before it falls if you have the required free hands and Capacity.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Transfer the Track
cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing gunner at another working ship weapon station; same ship and tracked target

Send the target bearing to their display. This supplies a bearing only and does not grant a target lock or an attack.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.

cards.name: Treat Bone
cards.gear: No equipment is granted. Provide any access and materials required by the wound's remedy; a med bay or medkit does not grant this capability.
cards.text:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Time:** One hour.

**Target / range / shape:** One wound on yourself or a willing patient listing Bone treatment.

Make a Knowledge treatment roll.

- **Weak:** Add 1 recovery progress.
- **Standard:** Add 2 recovery progress.
- **Strong:** Add 3 recovery progress.

**Duration:** Recovery progress remains with that wound; at its RV remove only the printed treatable effects. The scar still counts.

**Equipment / acquisition:** No equipment is granted. Provide any access and materials required by the wound's remedy; a med bay or medkit does not grant this capability.

cards.gear: Requires any equipment named above. Grants no equipment.
cards.text:

**Target / range / shape:** Self, next to a waist-high stable obstacle

Cross the obstacle into a clear adjacent square on its far side, paying its normal movement cost.

**Duration:** Instant unless the effect states a duration.
